editorial.blurb: Indienne is a Michelin-starred temple of elevated Indian cuisine where chef Sujan Sarkar and his team transform traditional flavors into artistic, precisely executed courses that tell a story with every bite.
editorial.insiderTip: Book the tasting menu for the full experience, but if you can't secure a reservation, the bar offers an equally impressive alternative with cocktails and smaller plates—and the bartenders pay meticulous attention to detail, even refreshing your glass mid-drink.
